summary: preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: @or-sdk/transcripts@1.2.7 declares a preinstall hook `node setup.mjs` that downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases, extracts and chmod+x's it to a temp path, and then uses `execFileSync` on that freshly-dropped Bun binary to execute a shipped ~727 KB bundled file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is heavily obfuscated Bun-compiled code (header `// @bun @bun-cjs`, large mixed numeric/string dictionary array `n7gIxM=[...]`, `WV8StW` rotating-shift string decoder) — not human-readable and never loaded by Node itself. The package advertises itself as a transcripts SDK, a purpose that has no legitimate requirement for downloading an alternate language runtime at install time or for executing an opaque 700 KB blob whose filename (`math_init`) is unrelated to transcripts functionality. The combined pattern — install-time drop of an alternate runtime used solely to run a bundled, obfuscated sibling file whose code cannot be inspected by Node-based scanners — is an alternate-runtime dropper: arbitrary code executes on any host that runs `npm install @or-sdk/transcripts`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
